scene.note: One stylesheet, linked from both pages, gives the studio's pages the colours and letters of the studio itself.

steps.note: styles.css holds Dilys's notes, but no page loads it.
A link in the head of each page loads styles.css as a stylesheet.
Now the browser reads the stylesheet along with each page.
Dilys gives two colours as codes: one for behind the page, one for the writing.
A rule for the body sets its background colour and its text colour.
Visitors see a cream page with dark brown writing, on both pages.
Dilys wants the letters of the sign over the door, and bigger writing.

value.label: the font list
values: a family to fall back on

steps.note: The body rule names the font, then a general family in case a computer does not have it, and a text size.
Every heading, paragraph and link takes the new letters and size.
